title: Constraint equations for the common-stage completed tensor lift
statement:
theorem completed_tensor_common_lift_constraints
    (N : ∀ E, CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    (coherence : RingedDerivedTensorCoherence.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R) closed models symmetry)
    (data : CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit l X R closed models symmetry) :
    Nonempty (CompletedTensorCommonLiftConstraints l X R closed models symmetry
      data.tensor data.unit)

source.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; HRS Lemma 7.9; common-field tensor descent.

proof.text: Apply the finite-field representative calculation and native associator transport to the tensorator and unit data.
Apply the finite coefficient multiplication calculation and native left-unitor transport to the tensorator and unit data.
Apply the finite coefficient multiplication calculation and native right-unitor transport to the tensorator and unit data.
Apply the finite signed-swap calculation and native symmetry transport to the tensorator data.
